title: ci: install golangci-lint via golangci-lint-action
body:
Fixes #2916.

Replaces the `curl | sh` install of golangci-lint in the `validate` and `osx`
jobs with `golangci/golangci-lint-action` (`install-only`), and makes the
Makefile able to consume a linter from `$PATH` so that actually takes effect.
Rationale is in the commit messages.

### Testing

Verified locally that the linter resolves correctly in all three cases, using a
stubbed `curl` to detect any download attempt:

| golangci-lint on `$PATH` | resolves to | `make tools` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| absent | `$(GOBIN)/golangci-lint` | installs |
| matching version | `golangci-lint` | skipped |
| non-matching version | `$(GOBIN)/golangci-lint` | reinstalls |

The third case is the one the old existence-only check got wrong.

### Notes for review

- The first commit is an unrelated bug found while testing this one: `$(GOPATH)`
  is a make variable that is normally unset, so `GOBIN` silently became `/bin`.
  Kept separate, and ordered first because the second commit depends on
  `$(GOBIN)` resolving to a real path.
- The version is parsed once in the existing `path-filter` job and passed along
  as an output, rather than inline in both jobs podman-style. Both jobs already
  depend on `path-filter`, and the file uses that pattern for
  `AUTOMATION_RELEASE` — though that hoist has a forcing reason (GHA rejects
  `${{ env }}` in container image names) and this one does not. Happy to move it
  inline if preferred.
- Go build/module caching (@mtrmac's point about `actions/setup-go` versus the
  Fedora RPM Go) is deliberately out of scope — it touches every container job
  and needs before/after timings. #2919 already tracks it.
